limitations: Training, validation and test projects follow the same authored scenario families and response templates. The 64-case result does not establish broad real-world reliability.
The test set comprises four project groups with 16 counterfactual variants each. Those 64 cases are not 64 independent customers.
No before/after generated-answer comparison on the DTE test set is available. Validation token metrics are not full-answer accuracy.
Python checks supplied facts and calculation values. It does not verify customer claims, current funding or every sentence of generated prose.
The same errors on CPU and MPS do not identify a single causal input feature. Broader wording and combination tests remain future work.
